event_chain.summary: Email servers breached, method not disclosed

summary: During the night of Dec 11-12 2025 attackers breached email servers of the French Ministry of the Interior and gained access to a number of document files. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez confirmed the cyberattack, said there was no evidence the files were seriously compromised, and the ministry tightened security protocols and access controls.
